title: Aging Well, Sleeping Efficiently: Protecting Health In Later Life
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to see whether protecting sleep quality in later life is important in continued healthy aging. The value of education in healthy sleep practices along with reducing time in bed each night by going to bed 30 minutes later, and of healthy dietary practices will be tested for their effects on sleep quality, health, and well being.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 75 or older
* without sleep disorders
* without psychiatric disorders
* Folstein MMSE of 24 or greater

Exclusion Criteria:

* Apnea-hypopnea index greater than 30
* Mean sleep latency less than 6
* Psychotropic medications present
